name: BTE hearing aid
definition: case behind the ear with a tube to an ear mould.
notes: Page defines BTE as electronics behind the ear with sound sent down a hollow tube.

name: RIC hearing aid
definition: case behind the ear with a thin wire to a receiver in the ear canal.
notes: Page: RIC speaker sits in the ear canal on a thin wire; about 80% of US sales.

name: ITE hearing aid
definition: custom shell filling the outer ear.
notes: Page: ITE custom hard-shell aids inside the outer ear; full-shell and half-shell.

name: canal hearing aid
definition: custom device sitting in or deep in the ear canal (ITC, CIC and IIC are `shell_style` values).
notes: Page lists ITC, CIC and IIC as in-the-canal styles.

name: prescription spectacles
definition: glasses with lenses made to the wearer's prescription.
notes: Sold with prescription lenses, from $95; single vision, progressives, readers.

name: ready-made reading glasses
definition: glasses with fixed magnifying power, sold without a prescription.
notes: Zenni readers +0.25 to +2.75; Foster Grant reading glasses up to +3.50.

name: prescription sunglasses
definition: tinted spectacles with lenses made to a prescription.
notes: Sunglass Hut sells prescription sunglasses with branded prescription lenses.

name: low-vision spectacles
definition: spectacles with magnifying, prismatic or telescopic lenses in a spectacle frame, including flip-down magnifiers mounted on a frame.
notes: Bioptic telescopes on spectacle frames; Eschenbach maxTV 2.1x spectacle-style TV glasses.

name: handheld magnifier
definition: magnifier held in the hand, made and sold as a low-vision aid.
notes: Hand-held magnifiers sold in low-vision aid shops, lit and unlit.

name: stand magnifier
definition: magnifier on a stand or flat base resting on the page, made and sold as a low-vision aid.
notes: Stand magnifiers (Optelec, tilt-stand, illuminated) sold in low-vision aid shops.

name: soft contact lens
definition: flexible lens worn on the eye, of any schedule, correction or colour; a coloured lens without power is this kind with `corrective: no`.
notes: Lens.com sells soft lens brands by schedule, toric, multifocal and colour.

name: rigid gas-permeable contact lens
definition: rigid lens worn on the eye.
notes: Boston gas permeable lens materials for irregular corneas and astigmatism.

name: orthokeratology lens
definition: rigid lens worn overnight to reshape the cornea.
notes: Overnight ortho-k lenses (Euclid MAX, VST) for temporary myopia reduction.

name: scleral lens
definition: large rigid lens resting on the white of the eye.
notes: Zenlens scleral lenses fully vault the cornea; diameters 14.8 to 17.0 mm.

name: white cane
definition: cane made for a blind or low-vision person to detect obstacles.
notes: RNIB long canes collection: Ambutech, Awarewolf, WeWalk; cane tip filter.

name: communication aid
definition: device or board that helps a person speak or communicate.
notes: Speech generating (AAC) devices: TD I-110, TD Pilot, TD Navio, TD I-13/I-16.

name: oral antihistamine
definition: tablet, capsule or liquid taken for allergy symptoms.
notes: Walgreens allergy page lists Zyrtec, Claritin, Allegra, Xyzal tablets.

name: allergy nasal spray
definition: spray used in the nose for allergy symptoms.
notes: Allergy nasal sprays: Flonase, Nasacort, Astepro, Nasonex.

name: cough suppressant
definition: medicine that suppresses cough.
notes: Cough suppressant category; Delsym dextromethorphan polistirex 12 hour.

name: expectorant
definition: medicine that loosens phlegm.
notes: Category pairs suppressants with expectorants: Mucinex 12-Hour, Rompe Pecho EX.

name: nasal decongestant
definition: medicine that clears a blocked nose.
notes: Decongestant sprays (Afrin, Vicks Sinex oxymetazoline) and oral pseudoephedrine named.

name: cold and flu remedy
definition: combined medicine for cold and flu symptoms.
notes: Cold and flu medicine category: DayQuil/NyQuil, Theraflu, Mucinex combination liquids.

name: oral analgesic
definition: tablet, capsule or liquid taken for pain or fever.
notes: Oral pain relievers acetaminophen, ibuprofen, aspirin, naproxen; Tylenol caplets.

name: topical pain-relief gel
definition: gel or cream rubbed on for joint or muscle pain.
notes: Voltaren diclofenac gel, Biofreeze gel under topical pain relief.

name: lidocaine patch
definition: adhesive patch with a local anaesthetic.
notes: Salonpas lidocaine 4% gel-patch; Tylenol and Biofreeze patches listed.

name: migraine medicine
definition: medicine labelled for migraine.
notes: Excedrin Migraine caplets: aspirin, acetaminophen, caffeine, labelled for migraine.

name: sleep aid
definition: medicine labelled first as an aid to fall asleep (the same ingredient labelled first for allergy is an oral antihistamine).
notes: Sleep aids with diphenhydramine or doxylamine: ZzzQuil, Advil PM, Walgreens Sleep Aid.

name: delay spray
definition: topical anaesthetic spray to delay ejaculation.
notes: Lidocaine delay sprays: Stud 100 9.6%, Promescent 10 mg per spray.

name: emergency contraceptive pill
definition: pill taken after unprotected sex to prevent pregnancy.
notes: Take Action levonorgestrel 1.5 mg, product type Emergency Contraceptives.

name: teething gel
definition: gel applied to the gums of a teething baby.
notes: Walgreens Teething Relief type; Orajel cooling gels for teething, Mommy's Bliss gel.

name: medicinal enema
definition: enema containing a medicine (a plain enema bulb or anal douche is not a medicine).
notes: Fleet saline enema (sodium phosphate) sold as a laxative; Walgreens Enemas type.

name: nicotine replacement product
definition: patch, gum, lozenge, spray or inhaler that supplies nicotine to help stop smoking.
notes: Nicotine gum and lozenges as stop-smoking aids; Nicorette; patches Habitrol, NicoDerm CQ.

name: homeopathic single remedy (no labelled use)
definition: registered single homeopathic remedy sold with no indication; provisional, issued only if a fetched pharmacy page sells such remedies as their own category (memo section 14).
notes: German pharmacy category Einzelmittel 1g: Arnica C30, Rhus tox C30 globuli, no use given.

name: multivitamin
definition: supplement that combines many vitamins in one product.
notes: Multivitamins category: Nature Made, One A Day, Centrum, Geritol.

name: vitamin D supplement
definition: supplement whose single active ingredient is vitamin D.
notes: Nature Made Vitamin D3 2000 IU softgels; Vitamin D2 and D3 product types.

name: vitamin C supplement
definition: supplement whose single active ingredient is vitamin C.
notes: Walgreens product type Vitamin C: Emergen-C 1000 mg.

name: magnesium supplement
definition: supplement whose single active ingredient is magnesium.
notes: Magnesium glycinate supplements (Nature Made, Nature's Bounty); Walgreens Magnesium tier.

name: ashwagandha supplement
definition: supplement made from ashwagandha root or extract.
notes: Walgreens product type Ashwagandha; Nature Made Magnesium + Ashwagandha with Sensoril extract.

name: probiotic
definition: live-microbe supplement.
notes: Probiotic supplements: Culturelle, Align, Florastor, Garden of Life, ReNew Life.

name: fish oil
definition: omega-3 oil supplement from fish.
notes: Nature's Bounty Fish Oil with Omega 3 softgels 1000 mg; Fish Oil & Omegas shelf.

name: collagen supplement
definition: collagen in powder, drink or capsule, including those sold for skin, hair and nails.
notes: Collagen product type: Vital Proteins powder; also sold for hair, skin, nails.

name: restorative essence
definition: tonic or essence sold for health (for example essence of chicken).
notes: BRAND'S Essence of Chicken, general health drink, 68 ml bottles.

name: multi-ingredient supplement
definition: product mixing ingredient classes (for example a joint formula, or a hair, skin and nails formula).
notes: X Ray Dol Triple Action Joint Health Supplement with Vitamin D tablets.

name: protein powder
definition: powder sold for its protein, for training or recovery.
notes: ON protein powders: Gold Standard 100% Whey, Isolate, Casein, Serious Mass.

name: protein bar
definition: bar sold for its protein.
notes: Quest protein bars, 20g protein; also minis and protein chips.

name: creatine
definition: creatine sold as a training supplement.
notes: ON Micronized Creatine 5 g per serving; Cellucor creatine powders.

name: pre-workout
definition: powder or drink taken before training.
notes: Cellucor Pre Workout collection (11 products), C4 line with 200 mg caffeine.

name: amino-acid supplement
definition: amino acids (for example BCAA, arginine, glutamine) sold for training.
notes: ON BCAA 1000 capsules; Cellucor XTEND BCAA and EAA powders; glutamine capsules.

name: electrolyte or energy gel
definition: gel, tablet or drink mix for hydration or energy during exercise.
notes: GU energy gels; Nuun electrolyte tablets; GU hydration drink tabs.

name: meal-replacement shake
definition: shake or powder sold to replace a meal.
notes: Huel nutritionally complete meal replacement powders: Black Edition, Powder, Essential.

name: medical-condition formula
definition: formula made for a medical condition (hypoallergenic, amino-acid or metabolic formulas); a food, not a supplement.
notes: Phenyl-Free 2 PKU medical food; Nutramigen hypoallergenic infant formula.
